cases.title: Open a signing link with no account
steps: Go to the Outbox
On person_b's "your turn" entry, open "Open signing page as this recipient ↗" in a private window
expected: The signing page opens without asking to sign in
It says who asked you to sign and the file name
Only person_b's fields are highlighted; other people's are grey and can't be clicked
The top shows "N fields left"

cases.title: Sign by typing your name (dialog)
steps: Click "Next field" until a "Sign here" box is highlighted
Click "Sign here"
Check the dialog
Click "Apply"
expected: The dialog opens on "Type your name", already filled with your name (your own "Name" field if you filled it, else the name the sender entered), with a large handwriting-style preview
After Apply the signature appears in the box, scaled to fit
The box turns green and "fields left" goes down by one

cases.title: Initials fit a small box
preconditions: A sent document with an initials box for this signer
steps: Type "Casey J. Lee" into your "Name:" field
Click the "Initial here" (or "Initial") box
Change the text to "CL" if you like
Click "Apply"
expected: The dialog is pre-filled with "CJL"
The initials appear centred in the small box, scaled to fit
The next initials box opens pre-filled with what you used last

cases.title: Draw a signature instead
steps: Click a "Sign here" box
Click the "Draw" tab in the dialog
Draw a squiggle on the pad
Click "Apply"
expected: The drawing appears in the box, scaled to fit
Clicking it again reopens the dialog to change it

cases.title: Fill text, date and checkbox fields, then finish
steps: Click "Next field" and type into each highlighted text box
Check that date fields already hold today's date (change one if you like)
Check that "Finish" stays greyed out while fields are left
When it says "All required fields done", click "Finish"
expected: Typed text sits above the document's underline, not crossed by it
After Finish: "✓ You've signed …"
Opening the same link again shows the same confirmation, not the form

cases.title: Radio choice allows exactly one option
preconditions: services_choices sent (radio choices belong to this signer, none pre-selected)
steps: In one question, click the first option
In the same question, click the third option
Leave another required question unanswered and check "Finish"
expected: Only the third option shows a dot; the first is cleared
"Finish" stays greyed out until every required question has an answer
Each question counts once in "fields left", not once per option

cases.title: Pre-filled fields are locked
preconditions: REV-10 and/or REV-11 done before sending
Open the signing link of the person the values were pre-filled for
steps: Find the pre-filled box
Try to click into it and type
expected: The value is shown in a grey dashed box (hover says "Filled in by the sender")
It can't be changed, and it isn't counted in "fields left"
After Finish, the final PDF shows the pre-filled value, not anything else

cases.title: Values from earlier signers are visible to later ones
preconditions: person_a has signed; person_b has not
steps: Open person_b's signing link
Look at person_a's text fields on the page
expected: person_a's typed values are shown (read-only); their signature image is not

cases.title: Everyone signs: completed and downloadable
preconditions: All but one signer have signed
steps: Sign as the last signer and click "Finish"
Click "Download the signed PDF"
Open the downloaded PDF
expected: The confirmation says "Everyone has signed"
The PDF shows every signature, text, date, tick and radio dot in its box
The sender's Status page shows "completed" and "Download signed PDF"

cases.title: Back to the Outbox after signing
preconditions: A sent document with an unsigned recipient
steps: Go to the Outbox
Click "Open signing page as this recipient ↗"
Complete the fields and click "Finish"
Click "← Back to Outbox"
Open the same signing link in a private window
expected: After Finish, the confirmation shows "← Back to Outbox" and "View document status"
"← Back to Outbox" opens the Outbox, now with a "signed" entry
In the private window (a real recipient) neither link is shown
